merge_decisions: Used RelayBar 0.7 Button Families as the unified source foundation.
Verified the 0.7 ContextStack.swift / ContextStackMac.swift are byte-identical to the supplied 0.5 Context Stack branch and the 0.6 Pinned Chats combined branch.
Verified the 0.7 PinnedChats.swift / PinnedChatsAX.swift / PinnedChatsMac.swift are byte-identical to the supplied 0.6 Pinned Chats branch.
Preserved the 0.7 ButtonHierarchy and family presentation layer.
Replaced NativeMenus.swift with the supplied/current 0.5.2 Menu Cascade engine; NativeAXSource.swift was already byte-identical between 0.7 Lean Scan and 0.5.2.
Replaced NativeMenuController.swift with the 0.5.2 Menu Cascade controller, changing only the release/report label for the unified build.
Added automatic transition into the App controls/Sheets page when a Sheet or Sheet document becomes active, while excluding screenshot-viewer interruption states.
Retargeted the conservative permission recovery helper to 0.8.0 build 13 and exposed it at package root as Fix_Access.command.
Removed current-product branch merge tooling; this package is the consolidated install source, not another patch branch.
